articles.title: Lakeside Farms Coqueiros Beach / Estúdio Vinicius Macêdo + Novais Arquitetura
english: The Lakeside Farms project, designed by Estúdio Vinicius Macêdo and Novais Arquitetura, showcases a harmonious relationship between built structures and the natural landscape of Aquiraz, Brazil. Completed in 2025, it emphasizes sustainable architecture and urbanism, pushing the boundaries of contemporary design principles.

One of the key challenges addressed was integrating the architecture with its surrounding environment. The design aims to enhance the natural beauty of the Coqueiros Beach area while providing functional spaces for residents and visitors alike.

This project not only serves as a residential area but also promotes ecological awareness. By incorporating green spaces and utilizing local materials, it sets an example for future developments in coastal areas.
chinese: 湖畔農場項目由Estúdio Vinicius Macêdo和Novais Arquitectura設計，展示了巴西Aquiraz的建築與自然景觀之間的和諧關係。該項目於2025年完成，強調可持續建築和都市設計，挑戰當代設計原則的邊界。
應對的關鍵挑戰之一是將建築與周圍環境整合。這一設計旨在提升科基羅斯海灘區域的自然美，同時為居民和遊客提供功能性的空間。
該項目不僅是一個住宅區，還促進了生態意識。通過融合綠色空間和利用當地材料，它為未來沿海地區的發展樹立了榜樣。

articles.title: Meganom shows infinity pool topping its skinny New York skyscraper
english: Russian architecture studio Meganom recently unveiled renderings of an infinity pool atop its nearly finished skyscraper at 262 Fifth Avenue, located in Manhattan's NoMad neighborhood. This structure is set to be the tallest all-residential building on Fifth Avenue, standing at 860 feet tall with 52 stories, just shy of the supertall skyscraper designation.

The design features a sleek glass and aluminum facade, maximizing space, light, and privacy for each residence. Each unit will have column-free interiors, allowing for breathtaking views of the Manhattan skyline that enhance the sense of openness and comfort, which is often hard to find in the city.

Despite facing challenges and scaling down the project, 262 Fifth Avenue has begun sales and is nearing completion, with installation of its cladding and windows well underway. Meganom's design continues to spark both excitement and criticism, especially regarding its impact on iconic view corridors nearby.
chinese: 俄羅斯建築工作室Meganom最近公布了位於曼哈頓NoMad區即將完成的262第五大道摩天大樓頂部無邊泳池的渲染圖。這座摩天大樓將成為第五大道上最高的全住宅建築，高達860英尺（約262米），擁有52層，僅比超高摩天大樓的標準低一些。
這座設計擁有纖細的玻璃和鋁外立面，最大化了每個住宅的空間、光線及隱私。每個單元都設計有無柱的室內空間，使得住戶能夠欣賞到壯麗的曼哈頓天際線，增強了城市中難得的開放感和舒適感。
儘管面臨挑戰並縮小了項目規模，262第五大道的銷售已經開始，並且即將完工，外立面的包覆和窗戶安裝工作正在進行中。Meganom的設計持續引發興奮與批評，特別是在對附近標誌性視野走廊的影響方面。

articles.title: LLDS reworks ‘northcote house’ in melbourne with robotically-milled interiors
english: The Northcote House project in Melbourne is a contemporary renovation that transforms a Victorian terrace on a compact site. Designed by LLDS, the structure elevates the ground plane to create a roof garden, thereby maximizing outdoor space in a dense urban environment. This innovative design not only enhances the ecological aspects of the house but also provides an open living area combining kitchen, dining, and entry into a single flowing volume.

At the center of the Northcote House, a circular snug facilitates natural daylight and air circulation, creating a fluid environment. Surrounding spaces, including bedroom suites, allow for seamless transitions without doors. The interior features a rich texture with dark green finishes and locally sourced materials, such as kangaroo hides, enriching the domestic atmosphere.

The façade of the Northcote House functions as a living surface, with both east and west elevations supporting climbing plants. This green design approach integrates with the surrounding community, providing a welcoming observation space and enhancing privacy through a small courtyard. The project emphasizes the use of sustainable materials and local production, reflecting a commitment to ecological and social integration.
chinese: 北科特住宅項目位於墨爾本，是一個將維多利亞式排屋轉變為當代住宅的整修計劃。由LLDS設計，結構抬高地面以創造屋頂花園，從而在密集的城市環境中最大化戶外空間。這一創新設計不僅增強了住宅的生態特徵，還提供了一個將廚房、餐廳和入口融合為一體的開放生活區。
在北科特住宅的中央，一個圓形的舒適區促進自然光的引入和空氣的流通，創造出流暢的環境。周圍的空間，包括臥室套房，實現了無門的無縫過渡。室內環境採用深綠色質感和當地來源的材料，如袋鼠皮，為居家氛圍增添了豐富的層次感。
北科特住宅的外立面起著生動的功能，東西兩側都支持攀爬植物。這種綠色設計方法與周圍社區融合，提供了舒適的觀察空間，並通過一個小庭院增強隱私。該項目強調使用可持續材料和本地生產，反映出對生態和社會整合的承諾。
